capacity_plan.extra_lane_note: NEEDLE adds up to 400 result slots/day separately. The base sample includes up to 600 control pages.
capacity_plan.qualification: Next-day inventory capacity, not measured daily replenishment or completed reads. New pages exclude all earlier selections. Controls repeat for 30 days; no substitution across categories.

replenishment.definition: Unique URLs first discovered after each source’s initial inventory day. Discovery is not publication, eligibility, or successful scraping. Days without recorded polls do not establish zero supply.
